item.title: Morepen files first US drug application, eyes generic diabetes market
item.description: Morepen’s first US submission targets a late-stage entry into the global diabetes therapeutics market, leveraging a DPP-4 inhibitor with potential competitive timelines and regulatory milestones

item.title: NMDC commissions ₹5,427 crore iron ore processing complex in Chhattisgarh; stock slides 2%
item.description: The commissioned project comprises three components: a new iron ore processing plant at Bacheli, a 135-kilometre, 15 MTPA slurry pipeline, and the 2 MTPA pellet plant at Nagarnar.

item.title: NSE shares slip below IPO price after lackluster India debut
item.description: The stock fell as much as 1.8 per cent to ₹1,761 on Monday, below the IPO price of ₹1,785
